verdicts.reason: A reverses the reading order: the Shop Sale CTA comes first on the far left, before the headline. 'WEEKEND ONLY' is demoted to a tiny tag at the end of the fine print, the product can is tiny, and a huge dead gap sits in the middle-right with the circle cropped at the edge. B reads left to right in a sensible order (headline, CTA, product, terms) and keeps '20% off' dominant. But 'Every mixed case.' is squeezed into an awkward three-line column, 'WEEKEND ONLY' is very small, and the fine print is about as big as the subhead, so it needs polish.
